name: Friend
tips: go <name> jumps to a pinned folder (Tab completes the name)
Ctrl+R searches the commands you typed before
admin opens an Administrator terminal (Windows asks first)
reload re-reads this file and your colours
Ctrl+Alt+T opens a terminal from anywhere
status shows the PC panel again, banner shows everything
the PC status is live when a terminal opens; press any key to start typing (live opens the bigger dashboard)
z docs jumps to any folder you have used (z with no letters lists them)
apps start notepad  /  apps stop all  (the apps list is in this file)
weather city <your city> shows today's weather in the banner; Win + the key under Esc drops a terminal from the top
emblem switches this window's emblem; emblem picture on draws it as a real picture (Windows Terminal 1.22+)
sounds: startup_sound and admin_sound in my-terminal.json take default, off, a Windows sound like tada.wav, or your own .wav file
errors: when a command fails, a line under the red text says what it means; turn it off with error_hints false in my-terminal.json
suggestions: type a letter and a list of your earlier commands shows up; Down arrow walks into it, Tab opens a menu of every match, F2 switches style
slow commands: a sound and a pop-up tell you when a command that took over 30 seconds finishes while you are in another window; longdone 20 changes the time, longdone test plays it
looks: look switches the welcome screen (centre, wall, middle, classic); look panels / look add git choose the boxes
mouse: on the live welcome screen click a pinned folder or a recent project to go there, or a tool to start it; "mouse": false in my-terminal.json turns it off
